violated_contract: Cloudflare policy provisioning must interpret the observed API type and distinguish successful asynchronous creation from read visibility, without issuing a second creation when confirmation is delayed. Eddy's first production resource provisioning rejected the live Vectorize Number enum despite a successful creation; its next attempt rejected an immediately absent read that later became present.
canonical_prevention: Keep policy decoding and bounded post-creation observation in the Wrangler release adapter. Accept only the explicit documented/live enum values, reject wrong or unknown types, and poll authoritative absence after exactly one mutation. Permission, transport and type errors stop immediately; exhausted observation leaves an unknown journal event requiring reconciliation. Exercise API responses and the actual transaction owner, including delayed success, denied observation and forbidden replay.
